$comment: Route table for an [OI]-compatible marketplace (inferhub.dev shape: ns/model ids). Verified 2026-10-22 — see presets/INFERHUB.md. Use: route --preset presets/inferhub.json ...

quick.description: Small, well-specified change. Verified: passes the parse-duration bench in one shot.

build.description: Normal feature or fix. Tier below the top model, ~7-9x the quick route per task.

deep.description: Architecture, migrations, auth, payments, data, or anything unclear.

escalate.description: Only after a failed check. Different family, so a bad assumption is not repeated.

verify.description: Checks a finished change. Never edits code.
checks: run the checks the route asked for

curl.note: For a raw HTTP call: reads OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment.

avoid.$comment: Advertised but not serving on 2026-10-22. Re-probe before believing this list.
